nodes.name: Manual Test Run
nodes.notes: Lets an operator (or `n8n execute --id=...`) run this workflow on demand, without waiting for the hourly schedule, for setup verification.

nodes.name: Get Due Checkpoints
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData is required here, not on the node downstream: an n8n HTTP Request node's JSON-array response auto-splits into one n8n item per array element, so zero due checkpoints means zero items — and n8n never queues a downstream node when its only upstream output has zero items (confirmed by inspecting n8n-core's workflow-execute.js while building this workflow). With this flag, an empty response still produces one placeholder item (json: {}) so Summarize Due Count always runs.
